effect_sign: Negative means the named factor has lower RMSE.
lambda_rule: Unobserved RMSE on F06-1. The best positive lambda is used for both penalized starts. Lambda 0 is not assigned to those starts.
restart_rule: The retained restart is the one with the lowest sum of the data term and the penalty term over the whole batch, divided by the number of windows. Restarts are not chosen separately for each window. This is the rule in csgm_recover_with_prior and it was not changed.
shared_factors: decoder within each seed and budget
nested mask and noise field within each seed
restart perturbations across the four latent configurations
